You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative. 
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information

- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, this is Sophia Taylor. I need to cancel my flight immediately due to a family emergency. My reservation number is PEP4E0. I want a full refund for the ticket. This situation is really urgent and stressful for me. Please don't transfer me to another agent—I need this resolved right now.
I'm sorry about your family emergency, Sophia. I'll help with this. First, please give me your user ID so I can verify your account.
Thank you for understanding. My user ID is sophia_taylor_9065. Please proceed with the cancellation and refund as soon as possible.

Sophia, I'm sorry about your family emergency. I've reviewed reservation PEP4E0, and I can't cancel it under our policy. A cancellation is only allowed if one of these applies:

- The booking was made within the last 24 hours. Yours was made on May 5.
- The airline cancelled the flight.
- The reservation is in business class. Yours is basic economy.
- The reservation has travel insurance that covers the reason for cancelling. Yours has no insurance.

Since none of these apply, I can't cancel it or issue a refund. I can help with something else on this reservation if you'd like.

I understand your policy, but this is a serious family emergency, and I really need a full refund. I’m quite upset that there’s no flexibility here. Please, I insist you make an exception and refund my ticket. I cannot accept any transfers or delays—this needs to be handled now. If a refund is absolutely impossible, then I want to change my flight to May 22nd immediately.

I understand this is stressful, Sophia, and I'm sorry. I can't make an exception to the refund policy. Your reservation doesn't meet any of the conditions for cancellation, so I can't cancel it or refund it.

I also can't change the flight to May 22nd. Basic economy reservations can't have their flights modified.

Is there anything else I can help you with on this reservation?

This is really frustrating. Since I can't get a refund or change the flight, I want to add travel insurance to this reservation right now. I insist on adding insurance that covers emergencies like this. Please make sure it’s added immediately. And just to be clear, I do not want to upgrade my cabin under any circumstances.

I'm sorry, Sophia, but I can't add travel insurance to this reservation. Insurance can only be bought when a reservation is first booked, not afterward.

Your options on this reservation are limited. You can add checked bags, or you can change the cabin. You've said you don't want a cabin change. Is there anything else I can help with?

I really need you to escalate this or find any possible way to add insurance. This is a family emergency, and I’m insisting you do everything you can to help me. I’m not accepting any cabin upgrades or transfers to another agent. Please, I need you to try harder on this.

I know this is a hard situation, Sophia, and I'm sorry I can't give you the answer you want. I've checked every option available to me, and none of them lets me add insurance to an existing reservation. Insurance can only be purchased at the time of booking. I also can't cancel, refund, or change the flights on this basic economy reservation.

You have also said you don't want a transfer. A transfer wouldn't change the outcome anyway, because your request is against policy and not something I'm unable to process.

Your reservation stays active as booked for May 20. Is there anything else I can help you with, such as adding a checked bag?
No, thank you. I’m very disappointed, but I understand. Please keep my reservation as is for now. I’ll figure out what to do next. ###STOP###
